additional_info.subject: ID0474894-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R5 170001931] Black Screen Issue CRM:00263000416
additional_info.body:
Dear
Mert Kanneci
,
We are sending this email regarding a problem with your charger:
O204 Tesisleri-2(İstanbul yönü)
which led to the opened ticket:
0474894
.
We are investigating the issue and would like to have more details about the problem:
The charger is totally black or it's showing a back light and doesn't have the image?
When it's turned on, it's always black or during the turn on process shows any kind of image?
Do you see any damaged signs on the front screen?
Have you updated already the display controller?
After provide us with this answers, we will let you know the next steps, probably we will need to replace the DP Cable, do you have any spare of this cable to use ? (1,5meters)
Once you have this information, please forward to us and we will investigate the problem. We really appreciate your help and look forward to getting this sorted out soon!
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0474894

TR
SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center

O204 Tesisleri-2(İstanbul yönü)
Charger ID / Serial No.:
nEieOi
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
High
Handover reason:  black screen issue
▹ Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB, If the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is OK:
▹ Verify if the DP cable is properly attached
▹ If both are OK then replace the HMI
I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger:
• PANEL_ID
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1 | Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/o AC cutout
• MIDDLE_SEGMENT 8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8
• ADAPTER 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,

Felipe Moraes
